meta.title: Privacy Policy | Ananta Corporation
meta.description: How Ananta Corporation collects, uses and protects the information you share through our website enquiry form, chat and WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Ananta Corporation (GSTIN 24ACDFA7104Q1ZB) is a supplier of plywood, MDF, boards, flush doors and smart locks, located at 293/2, Godown No. 17, Nanukaka Estate, Opp. Sub Station, Pirana Road, Piplaj, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382405, India. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Enquiry form: when you send an enquiry we collect your name, phone number, email address, and any details you include about your product interest, quantity and project.
Chat assistant: if you use the on-site chat, we process the messages you type, and — if you choose to continue a conversation — the email address you verify.
WhatsApp: tapping a "Get Price on WhatsApp" button opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message; any conversation there is governed by WhatsApp's own terms and privacy policy.
We do not collect payment information through this website, and we do not use invasive tracking or sell advertising.

sections.heading: How we use your information
body: We use the details you share solely to respond to your enquiry — to send pricing, check stock, arrange samples or delivery, and follow up on your request. If you have asked us to, we may contact you about related products or availability.
We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information.

sections.heading: Sharing and service providers
body: Your information is shared only with the service providers that make this website work — for example, our hosting platform and the email service that delivers enquiry notifications and verification codes. These providers process data on our behalf and are not permitted to use it for their own purposes.

sections.heading: Retention and your rights
body: We keep enquiry details only as long as needed to handle your request and any resulting business relationship. You can ask us at any time to access, correct or delete the information we hold about you — email info@anantacorporation.com and we will action it promptly.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Questions about this policy or your data: email info@anantacorporation.com, call +91 83200 52838, or write to Ananta Corporation, 293/2, Godown No. 17, Nanukaka Estate, Opp. Sub Station, Pirana Road, Piplaj, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382405.

meta.title: Terms of Service | Ananta Corporation
meta.description: Terms of use for the Ananta Corporation website — product information, quotations, orders and intellectual property.

sections.heading: About these terms
body: This website is operated by Ananta Corporation (GSTIN 24ACDFA7104Q1ZB), Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. By using the site you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Product information
body: We work hard to keep product descriptions, specifications, sizes and certifications accurate, and they reflect manufacturer-published information for the brands we supply. Specifications can change at the manufacturer's end — always confirm the exact specification, grade and size with our team before placing an order.
Product and brand names (Duroply, DURODOOR, Action TESA, Tenon Smart Lock and others) belong to their respective owners; we use them as an authorized supplier/distributor of those products.

sections.heading: Pricing and quotations
body: We do not publish prices on this website. Pricing is provided on request — via WhatsApp or the enquiry form — and reflects current market rates, quantities and delivery location. A quotation is valid only for the period stated in it and is subject to stock availability.

sections.heading: Orders and delivery
body: Orders, payment terms and delivery timelines are agreed per transaction at the time of confirmation. Delivery is arranged as per location and availability. Please inspect goods on delivery and raise any discrepancy with our team immediately.

sections.heading: Intellectual property and acceptable use
body: The content of this website — text, layout and design — belongs to Ananta Corporation unless otherwise noted (product imagery and décor swatches belong to their respective brands). You may not scrape, republish or use the content for competing commercial purposes without permission, and you agree not to misuse the site's forms or chat.

sections.heading: Liability
body: This website is provided on an as-is basis. While we keep information current, we accept no liability for decisions made solely on the basis of website content without confirmation from our team. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

sections.heading: Governing law and contact
body: These terms are governed by the laws of India, with courts at Ahmedabad, Gujarat having jurisdiction. Questions: info@anantacorporation.com · +91 83200 52838.
